milestones.goal: An automated client is minted for and a different context's fetch is recorded — end to end on seeded input. Deployable.
The record survives the server: bundle written, verified offline, replay seeded.
A judge can read the claim and run it offline in one command.

tasks.title: Package skeleton, schema and append-only ledger
tasks.objective: SQLite schema and the only module that writes to it, with /24 IP truncation at the boundary
acceptance: WHEN a request row is written THE SYSTEM SHALL store the IP truncated to /24 and never the full address
tasks.rollback: git revert the T01 commit; delete the sqlite file

tasks.title: Human-exclusion gate and request-context derivation
tasks.objective: Classify automated vs human conservatively, and derive a stable ctx_id that is explicitly not an identity
acceptance: AC-1
WHEN a request carries Accept-Language plus any Sec-Fetch-* header THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mint and SHALL NOT write any ledger row

tasks.title: Mint, maze surface and an always-200 canary route
tasks.objective: HMAC mint with salt epochs, a minimal maze that embeds the per-context canary URL, and a canary route that returns 200 for every context
acceptance: AC-2
WHEN a canary URL is requested by any context THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200, because a 404 for the second context makes a sighting impossible

tasks.title: Sighting detection
tasks.objective: A fetch of secret S by a context other than S's mint context writes exactly one sighting carrying both raw request rows
acceptance: AC-3
AC-4
WHEN the minting context re-fetches its own canary THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT write a sighting

tasks.title: Evidence bundle writer and offline verifier
tasks.objective: Canonicalized rows, SHA-256 leaves, a Merkle root, and a verifier that needs no server and no network and names the failing row
acceptance: AC-5
AC-6
WHEN any byte of any bundled row is altered THE SYSTEM SHALL fail and name the failing row

tasks.title: Seeded two-client replay and viewer export
tasks.objective: The primary deliverable: two controlled clients produce a real mint and a real sighting through the real code path, labelled seeded, plus the JSON the viewer reads
acceptance: AC-8
WHEN the replay runs THE SYSTEM SHALL mark every row it creates origin=seeded and SHALL leave the organic count untouched

tasks.title: Viewer: port the prototype with the skeptical-evaluator fixes
tasks.objective: Render every line of copy FROM export.json so no state can contradict itself; replace the figure with a context diff; promote offline verification to the payoff; give the log records a scroll affordance
acceptance: AC-8
WHEN the partial state renders THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT display a second context's details, because none has been observed
WHEN the error state renders THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT assert a sighting it could not read
WHEN any state renders THE SYSTEM SHALL derive the claim sentence and the scope line from the data rather than from a hardcoded string
observe: at 390px no log record begins mid-token and every scrollable record shows an edge affordance
tasks.rollback: git revert the T07 commit; ui-prototype/index.html still renders

tasks.title: make demo and make verify, offline and deterministic
tasks.objective: One command on a clean checkout with no network produces the viewer and prints PASS, and proves the proof graph is byte-identical with the model disabled
acceptance: AC-7
AC-9
WHEN make verify runs with the server stopped THE SYSTEM SHALL print PASS and make no network call

tasks.title: [SAHARSH, Sat 10:00] Domain, DNS, TLS, sitemap, first deploy
tasks.objective: Get the canary surface publicly reachable as early as possible, because the organic-sighting clock starts when DNS resolves
acceptance: observe: the canary surface answers 200 over HTTPS on a stable public hostname
observe: /sitemap.xml lists the maze pages and no proof-of-work gate sits in front of them
verify: observe: deployed URL returns 200 and sitemap.xml lists maze pages
tasks.rollback: point DNS back; the ledger and bundle are files and survive
tasks.notes: NO CODE DEPS — start this at 10:00 Saturday, before anything else. It is the long pole and it is mostly waiting.

tasks.title: [SAHARSH, Sun] Chat-paste trigger and honest organic harvest
tasks.objective: Paste minted URLs into public model products, record which fetchers return, and report the organic count exactly as it stands
acceptance: WHEN results are reported THE SYSTEM SHALL separate organic from seeded and from paste-triggered
observe: docs/RESULTS.md states the organic count even if it is zero
verify: observe: RESULTS.md separates organic, seeded and paste-triggered
tasks.notes: A paste-triggered fetch shows a fetcher following a human's paste, NOT two agents sharing. Must be labelled as its own category.

tasks.title: Merged gate: fresh review, security checklist, QA
tasks.objective: One fresh reviewer on the final branch running the security checklist, plus the demo flow three times and the prod-ui A8 gates
acceptance: observe: a fresh reviewer's findings are recorded and each blocking one is reproduced before it is fixed
observe: secrets scan clean and the HMAC salt is not committed
observe: make demo run three times in a row with a reset between
verify: observe: fresh review recorded, secrets scan clean, demo run three times
